comment: The PLAY/PAUSE button and the PLAY/PAUSE jack are both dead as shipped. They are declared at src/Metriks.cpp:18 and :24 and configured at :216 and :219, and nothing else in the file reads either; the maker's own manual says they are reserved for a Peak Counter mode that is not written. Both get a line saying so, because an untagged control falls back to the maker's tooltip, which would promise a function. The RESET button and jack are read at :920 and only do anything in the voltmeter's Minimum, Maximum and Median settings (:922-930); in CV Pitch they do nothing. The OUT jack is a straight copy of IN on one channel (:742). The input is read with plain getVoltage, so a polyphonic cable is measured on its first channel only. The encoder is configured with infinite limits at :214 and is read as a delta at :746. The 10-second option timeout is at :1013. The Model submenu is on every module in this plugin and is left out per the house rule; it is listed once in the plugin-level notes.
